description: Godot 4.7 animation APIs: AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree state machines, AnimatedSprite2D and create_tween() Tweens, with a headless state test. Use when travel() does nothing, an animation will not play, a tween snaps back or the log says "Animation not found". Not for easing choices (`game-feel`), sprite art (`create-game-assets`) or Unity (`unity-animation`).
